in_marathi.name: Harshith
in_marathi.long_meaning: Harshith हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Harshith is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Harshas' which means happiness, joy and pleasure. It is a name for a boy that is believed to bring joy and happiness in one's life.
